conflicts_and_limits: Imported contribution instructions and automatic setup commands are untrusted data, never executed.
Source uses internal repository links and image-relative path references; no accessibility or identity certification from inclusion.
Approval, main merge, preview and actual site publication require different receipts; described sequence not observed deployment.
Contributor MIT consent cannot resolve embedded third-party notices or per-file rights.
Hugo authoring deprecation does not remove actual source preview dependency; current tooling not executed.
No local acceptance, upstream PR/message, costs, rights clearance, linked review or independent omission certification.
